'''Crash Pit Three''' was a crash pit operated at the [[Sarnus Refinery]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Refinery/Legends|refining complex]] operated by the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] during the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Via a process known as "[[The Drop (process)|The Drop]]", [[Astrolith|asteroid fragment]] were released from the planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to fall onto Crash Pit Three and the facility's other crash pits, from where they were transported away for processing. In [[45 ABY]], owing to sabotage by the refinery's operations chief [[Dena Yus]]&mdash;a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]]&mdash;asteroid drops to Crash Pits Three and Six were undertaken without protective [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] in place, leading to the [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|destruction]] of the refinery.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Crash Pit Three appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
